Definition: from G4206 with adverbial enclitic of source; from far, or (by implication) at a distance, i.e. distantly:--afar off.
BiblicalUsage: Porrhothe means from far, afar off. Luke shows ten lepers standing afar off as they cry for mercy, and Hebrews says the fathers died in faith, having seen the promises afar off and embraced them.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that faith sees from far off what sight cannot see up close, and the fathers died holding promises they never held in their hands.
